## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] `python -m ruff check .`
- [ ] `python -m ruff format --check .`
- [ ] `python -m pytest -q`
- [ ] Strategy/parity behavior is unchanged, or the intended change is documented

## Trading-risk impact

- [ ] No live-execution behavior changed
- [ ] Risk controls were reviewed if execution behavior changed
- [ ] Generated reports, credentials, and market-data files are not committed
